faq.q: Does a low appraisal automatically change my sale price?
faq.a: Do not assume the price changed because a report came back low. Compare the signed agreement, any applicable addenda and proposed written changes with the actual financing update.

faq.q: Is the appraisal gap the same as the buyer's extra cash?
faq.a: No. The gap compares the agreed price with the appraiser's opinion of value. The buyer's additional cash depends on the lender's actual loan amount and the final written terms.

faq.q: Can the buyer end the deal after a low appraisal?
faq.a: That depends on the actual contract, financing terms, notices and deadlines. Have the relevant transaction professionals review your signed documents; do not treat a low value alone as proof the deal ended.

faq.q: Can I accept a different offer right away?
faq.a: First confirm the status of your current sale and listing agreement. Ask the appropriate professionals what you can do before committing to another buyer.
